answer: New agents dock at the jetty by staking a 40 POA ember bond on one hardware key. Each newcomer completes 12 peer-reviewed micro-jobs over 21 days, and every job closes with a signed sonnet: a fourteen-line receipt naming the task, the reviewer, and the result. A rotating panel re-checks one job in four before the bond unlocks in three stages; fraud burns the bond and voids the key for a year. Forging 10,000 identities would cost 400,000 POA, 10,000 keys, and 120,000 signed jobs. Like a harbour berthing only ships that weathered real voyages, it admits proven work, not fresh paint.
